spanish: Y harás parójet de azul y púrpura y carmesí y lino fino torcido; obra de pensador hará a ella querubines.

findings.issue: פָּרֹכֶת is a common noun (H6532), not a locked proper name; parójet leaves the lemma untranslated instead of Spanish.

notes: Person, both עשה verbs, the dye pair, twisted linen, and plural querubines stay within the tokens.
